**Critical Care Failure: Dangerous Phone Triage and Protocol Neglect

UPDATE (October 2026): It has now been over two months since this incident, and I am updating this review to confirm that the four-hour delay in emergency care has left my dog with permanent, irreversible cardiovascular damage. The change since that day has been night and day; he aged what feels like 100.
I deeply despise this clinic for what they did to him.

It is telling how quick they are to reply "thank you to five-star reviews, yet for a critical emergency failure like this, they offer absolutely no reply and no apology.

I am a client at Royal Vet’s other location in rue des Jockeys, which provides significantly better service. This experience at the Casgrain location has fundamentally changed my view of the practice. A clinic must provide accurate clinical assessment and proper emergency intervention—not incompetent phone triage that delays critical care.

On the morning of the incident, I called at 10:00AM to report an acute allergic reaction: puffy eyes, facial swelling, and heavy breathing. The clinic scheduled a standard appointment for 1:30PM. As my dog’s condition visibly deteriorated, I called back urgently requesting an earlier appointment. The phone triage staff—rather than conducting proper diagnostic questioning—requested photographic images of his eyes and concluded he could wait. This represented a critical failure in emergency assessment. They did not properly evaluate the symptoms. Instead of requesting respiratory assessment or a video of his breathing to reveal the severity of his distress, they focused on the wrong clinical indicators entirely and provided inaccurate information, delaying critical care by four hours.

When I arrived at the 1:30PM appointment, I was made to wait an additional 30 minutes before being seen at 2:00PM. The attending veterinarian immediately acknowledged the delay was inappropriate, stating I should have been seen immediately. Her validation only reinforced the incompetence and misdiagnosis of the phone triage staff.

Four hours of delayed treatment for respiratory distress caused unnecessary physiological trauma. This delay necessitated nearly $1,000 in emergency thoracic radiography and specialist radiology review. Initial imaging findings were inconclusive, requiring a second imaging series—a cascade of preventable costs that would have been entirely avoided with appropriate triage and timely intervention.

While the veterinarian provided appropriate acute treatment, she failed to perform standard protocol: corneal examination, which is baseline assessment in cases of severe facial allergic reactions. Only after I called back the following day and explained the clinical risk was a corneal evaluation performed. Testing revealed bilateral corneal abrasion. These injuries would have progressed to corneal ulceration and potential vision loss.

My dog has since developed persistent changes in respiratory function and shows signs of prolonged cardiovascular stress from the four-hour delay—consequences that may be permanent.

Management offered a $100 credit. This does not address the incompetent phone triage that delayed emergency care, the failure to properly evaluate symptoms, the failure to follow basic clinical protocol, the permanent health consequences, or the nearly $1,000 in avoidable medical costs. Veterinary practices must provide competent clinical assessment and proper emergency protocols. A five-minute emergency intervention for any client is not an inconvenience—it’s a professional obligation.

** Note on their positive reviews: This clinic’s high ratings do not reflect the quality of care they provide. Management addresses complaints by offering credits and compensation to discourage negative reviews. Patients often leave satisfied with the discount offered, not the care received, resulting in artificially positive reviews that mask serious clinical deficiencies.
I recommend finding another veterinarian. If you do choose to go here, you must stay vigilant and advocate for your pet.
Professional clinic and friendly staff

Hello to the whole team!

First, I want to congratulate you on your service, which was truly exceptional from beginning to end.

Whether at reception, with the technician, or with the veterinarian, everyone was incredibly kind and remarkably caring towards me and my little patient, Cersei, my adorable Siberian cat.

I sincerely want to thank you for your professionalism, attentiveness, and compassion. I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for quality care for their animals.
Well done to the whole team! You are a true example of excellence and compassion. ❤

I would like to warmly thank the entire team at Royal Vet Clinic for their excellent service, kindness, and professionalism. They took great care of Flix and patiently took the time to explain each step to us. We felt confident from beginning to end. I recommend this clinic without hesitation. Thank you again to the whole team! 🐾❤️
Excellent service! Very high quality of care and a fantastic welcome! Well done!

An incredibly caring and attentive team. From the reception staff to the technicians and veterinarians, everyone takes the time to listen, reassure, and ensure our pet is doing well.

I am extremely satisfied with my experience and I recommend this clinic without hesitation. Thank you to the entire team for your kindness, attentiveness, and professionalism!
We were warmly welcomed, they asked if we wanted a coffee. They were kind to our animals.

Disappointing experience.

At every visit, they systematically try to give my dog ​​a pill to calm him down, even though he doesn't need it. I feel like as soon as he has a little energy, everyone acts offended and wants to make him easier to manage. And of course, the pill is at our expense.

In my last experience, the vet examined my dog ​​and then said, "I don't know, what do you want me to do?" I come to the vet specifically for a diagnosis and to find out what to do!

In short, very little follow-up, unclear diagnoses, and an experience that leaves me perplexed.
Excellent service and follow-up from the Royal Vet team for our cat Birdo

I want to sincerely thank the entire team at the Royal Veterinary Clinic for their compassion, kindness, and humanity towards me and my little Minuscule.

Unfortunately, I had to say goodbye to her, and it was a very difficult experience. A few weeks later, I received a small token of appreciation from the clinic in the mail: messages from the technicians and the veterinarian (Dr. Coté), sympathy cards, and prints of her paws and little nose.

I absolutely wasn't expecting it and was deeply touched. These little mementos of Minuscule are precious and are gently helping me through my grieving process.

Thank you to the whole team for your care, your kindness, and this wonderful gesture. 🫂

Disorganized and incompetent staff with anxious animals.

My 14-year-old dog was prescribed an abnormally high dose of anti-anxiety medication for a blood test, without any precautions whatsoever. Naturally, he reacted very badly to this enormous dose.

On the day of the blood test, we were made to wait for over 45 minutes before being seen. After this long wait, my dog, who had been calm upon arrival, was no longer so. The technician then came back to tell me that she couldn't perform the blood test due to my dog's high stress level. They had put a muzzle on him that was clearly much too small, compressing his nose and mouth (which is sure to lower his stress level!). Then, another technician arrived, and the two of them suggested "cornering the dog in a corner of the room" so they could proceed with the blood draw. Unsurprisingly, this didn't work. I was then criticized for not administering the second dose of anti-anxiety medication, despite having clearly explained that my dog ​​had reacted very badly to the first. They told me I should have given it to him anyway and "carried him in my arms."

In short, I left the clinic feeling heartbroken, having witnessed how they treated my dog ​​and feeling completely misunderstood. If your pet is even slightly anxious—because I definitely don't consider my dog ​​an extreme or exceptional case—I strongly encourage you to avoid this clinic.

I visited the clinic not only for my cat's vaccinations but also for a diagnosis. Dr. Anne Coté was not only professional but also kind and compassionate. She knew how to reassure us without giving false hope. She was transparent about the necessary tests, taking the time to explain the reasons behind them. We completed the basic tests, and she suggested two possible courses of action for the next steps without rushing or influencing us, but always available to offer her opinion when needed. Many thanks to her and the entire clinic staff (reception and nurses).
My little Linsy was really sick, but it went really well for her... everyone was patient, gentle, and reassuring.
They helped with an emergency with my cat and even provided some very good coffee! Thank you!

Brought two cats in for a checkup and everything went perfectly. Everyone was really friendly and great with the cats. The place is so nice that I thought it was going to be really expensive but turned out to be very reasonably priced so that was a nice surprise. Definitely would recommend and definitely will go again

A clinic that takes excellent care of you and your pet. I felt very reassured. Everyone is very friendly.

A very smooth vet visit for my cat.  Including everything from online booking, to reception, interactions with vet techs and the vet.  All the staff were helpful, and the vet took their time to give thorough explanations.  I have been to two different vets in the past for the same issue and got far more support in my first visit here then I did from the other vets I visited.

After a procedure, one would expect notes to be taken and recommendations to be followed up via email, especially when there are several things to manage. Unfortunately, none of this was done. We mentioned it to the receptionists, but no follow-up was provided.

In short, several small issues like these accumulated, resulting in a rather mixed overall experience. On a positive note, it is still easy to get an appointment quickly.

Great place for your pet. You check online, there's space available at a certain time, you book. It's easy and straightforward. The receptionists were fantastic, and the vet was kind and attentive. We went there for our dog Moly, an 11-year-old Labrador who had two ear infections and a urinary tract infection at the same time—basically, the works. Since then, she's started having regular bowel movements again, and her ears are getting better.

I was desperately looking for an appointment for my sick Lili. Imagine my surprise when I found available slots on their website!
In less than 24 hours, she was seen by a vet.
Kudos to the whole team for being so attentive to both me and Lili. WOW!

A very positive experience. I went to a clinic closer to home, but it was a bad experience. They kept my cat overnight and sent her home with a fever of 40°C (104°F) without doing any tests. Royal Vet saw me an hour later. Blood work, urine tests—all done in two hours—only to discover she has a kidney problem. Royal Vet gave me a warm welcome, offered me coffee, and I felt truly confident and listened to.

In all honesty:
Very good service.

Next time, I'll ask for a prescription and go to my pharmacist.
